about: Saint-Sauveur is a city in the Laurentians, Quebec, northwest of Montréal, long known as a ski-village and boutique resort town. Village streets, nearby ski hills, and year-round tourism in the lower Laurentians define the community. About 11,000 people live in Saint-Sauveur.
seoSummary: Laurentian ski-village city northwest of Montréal—boutiques, hills, and year-round resort tourism.
